description: Run Agency Growth's free AI audit of the user's business. Ask the user for each field first; never guess or invent any of them, and only call this once the user has given their name and email and agreed to receive the result by email. Takes about a minute. Returns the three automations ranked by hours or money saved, and a link to the full result.

budget.description: Budget to fix the problem: under-2k = Under $2K, 2k-5k = $2K to $5K, 5k-15k = $5K to $15K, 15k-50k = $15K to $50K, 50k-plus = $50K+.

email.description: The user's email. The full result is sent here.

hours_lost.description: Hours a week lost to the problem, optional.

industry.description: What the business does, e.g. "HVAC contractor".

problem.description: Their biggest operational problem, in their own words (at least a sentence).

revenue.description: Annual revenue band: under-500k = Under $500K, 500k-1m = $500K to $1M, 1m-2.5m = $1M to $2.5M, 2.5m-10m = $2.5M to $10M, 10m-plus = $10M+.

tried.description: What they have already tried, optional.

name: run_ai_audit
